blocks.text: Avida Land reopened its Glorietta Showroom on October 17, 2026, with a blessing ceremony held on the 2nd level of Glorietta 4, giving sales partners and prospective homeowners a more welcoming place to explore their options, and make informed decisions about their next home. The showroom has long been a venue where Avida’s events come to life and a place where its projects connect with the people they were built for. “As our business and our customers’ expectations evolve, it’s only right that this space evolves with them.
